CustomField.label: Match Guests on Phone + Last Name
CustomField.description: When ticked, an incoming guest with no usable email is matched to an existing contact that has the same phone number and last name. Off by default: such guests are created new and flagged as possible duplicates. Edit on the org-level PMS Settings record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Treat the same phone number plus last name as the same guest. Off = flag as possible duplicate only.
